name: The St. Regis Longboat Key Resort
positioning: An 18-acre Gulf-front St. Regis resort on Longboat Key, built around a 500,000-gallon saltwater snorkeling lagoon, a water-centered spa and Gulf-view suites
best_for: Families who want a guided snorkel lagoon, a Winding River and a children's club
Couples drawn to a hydrotherapy spa and an adults-only pool club
Travelers who want suites of one to four bedrooms with private terraces and Gulf views

facts.text: The St. Regis Longboat Key is an 18-acre coastal resort.
The Under the Sea Lagoon experiences are led by expert marine aquarists.
The St. Regis Spa is a 20,000-square-foot spa centered around the healing power of water, with indoor and outdoor vitality waters and an oceanfront relaxation room.
The resort has a Winding River for a leisurely float.
CW Prime serves steaks and seafood prepared on a Josper grill.
CW Prime won Wine Spectator's 2025 Award of Excellence.
Oshen is a rooftop lounge serving Nikkei cuisine, combining Japanese flavors and sushi with Peruvian spice.
The St. Regis Bar features a mural by Floridian artist William Savarese.
The resort's suites range from one to four bedrooms, with private terraces and views of the Gulf of Mexico.
All guests have access to St. Regis Butler Service.
The Reef Rangers children's club introduces children and teens to local wildlife and marine creatures.

highlights.text: The resort has a 500,000-gallon saltwater lagoon where guests can snorkel alongside marine life.
Guests can meet the resort's resident Aldabra giant tortoises.
The resort's exclusive signature service is a swimsuit refresh.
Nods to the original property on the site, such as the beachside Monkey Bar, can still be found at the resort.
The spa's outdoor vitality pool has six hydrotherapy pods and an infinity edge.

considerations.text: Pool and beach access is exclusive to overnight resort guests; public day passes are unavailable.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
The lagoon snorkel experience is for guests aged 8 and older; children under 8 can take part in the stingray portion.
